Overview

The hidden cost of Blockchain & Digital Trust for Insurance & Risk is never the model; it is the scaffolding — data contracts, evaluation harnesses, rollback machinery, audit evidence. We price and build that scaffolding explicitly, on policy admin platforms, because that is where programs actually succeed or die. Insurance & Risk punishes generic deployments. loss ratios moves faster than batch cycles, Solvency II reporting demands evidence chains most tools cannot produce, and the estate is heterogeneous — which is why every engagement starts with the seams named above rather than a platform-first rollout.

blocks.x: Failure modes & the guards we ship
Failure modes we design against, with the guard shipped for each:

items: On-chain PII
Personal data never written on-ledger — hashes and references only, verified in design review.
Ledger worship
The ledger used where tamper-evidence earns its cost — everything else stays a database with a backup.
Key fragility
Keys rotated on ceremony with HSM custody — the compromise of one secret is never the compromise of the estate.
